versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-xhs-content-collector.

- Provides public data collection for Xiaohongshu (小红书) including note search, note detail, comment fetch, and creator works monitoring.
- Command-line interface with four core scripts for different tasks: keyword search, note detail + comments, creator posts, and comment-only extraction.
- No need for login; processes only public data with high safety and up to 10,000 entries per run.
- Includes clear routing, parameter rules, input requirements, and error handling guidance.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable for API access.
- Not applicable to non-Xiaohongshu platforms or private/account data.
